hero.title: How It Works
hero.subtitle: Understanding how sound healing, movement and breathwork work together to clear static and restore natural flow
hero.intro: The body operates as a physical and electrical system. Thoughts, emotions and experiences create static and noise. Each modality addresses specific components of the system.
modalities: Sound healing works with the energy field using tuning forks to locate distortion and dissolve it. It promotes deep relaxation, emotional release and nervous system regulation.
Movement (Gyrotonic®) works with the physical body through spiraling, rhythmic movement. It improves posture, mobility and nervous system regulation.
Breathwork uses conscious breathing to work with circulation and the nervous system. It uplifts energy and improves circulation and mental clarity.

biofield.title: Biofield Tuning (Sound Healing)
biofield.whatItIs: A method working with your body's electrical system—the electric current inside tissue and the magnetic field surrounding it. Practitioners locate patterns of experiences and relationships (including memories) and hold tuning forks near areas of turbulence until the body reorganizes itself around the steady, coherent frequencies.
biofield.howItWorks: The practitioner listens for areas of resistance or resonance, holding the fork until the body harmonizes. Sessions often bring gentle shaking, sweating or emotional releases.
biofield.benefits: Deep relaxation, stress reduction, release of stored patterns and memories, improved energy flow and mental clarity. It is recommended to allow at least three sessions for full effect.

gyrotonic.title: Gyrotonic® Expansion System Method
gyrotonic.whatItIs: A movement method addressing your whole system by opening energy pathways and stimulating your nervous system. Specialized equipment (Pulley Tower®) provides smooth support and resistance.
gyrotonic.howItWorks: Flowing, circular movements originate from the torso, promoting balance, efficiency, strength and flexibility. The joints are decompressed and weight is distributed evenly.
gyrotonic.benefits: Improved posture, balance, strength and flexibility; regulated nervous system; adaptable to all abilities from injury recovery to elite performance.

breathwork.title: Breathwork (Gyrokinesis Cardiovascular Program)
breathwork.whatItIs: A breathing program developed by Juliu Horvath focusing on respiratory health through progressive breathing sequences and movement.
howItWorks: Rhythmic tapping to stimulate lymphatic flow
These stimulate all circulatory systems, increasing flow of blood, nutrients, oxygen and hormones
breathwork.benefits: Feeling lighter and uplifted, improved energy, mental clarity, better circulation and whole-body coordination.

items.question: What is sound healing?
items.answer: Sound healing uses specific frequencies from tuning forks to interact with your body's electromagnetic field. This helps release stored tension, emotions, and patterns, allowing your nervous system to return to a state of coherence and calm.

items.question: What should I expect in a session?
items.answer: Sessions begin with a brief discussion of your current state. For sound healing, you'll lie fully clothed on a treatment table while I work in your energy field with tuning forks. You may experience gentle shaking, emotional releases, or deep relaxation. Movement sessions involve guided exercises on specialized equipment.

items.question: Is sound healing safe?
items.answer: Yes, Biofield Tuning is a gentle, non-invasive practice. However, it's not recommended during pregnancy, for those with pacemakers, or during cancer treatment. Please inform me of any health conditions before your session.

items.question: How many sessions do I need?
items.answer: While you may feel shifts after one session, I recommend starting with three sessions to experience the full benefits. This allows time for integration and lasting change. We can then assess what ongoing support would be most beneficial.

items.question: What should I bring?
items.answer: Just yourself and comfortable clothing. For movement sessions, please wear clothes you can move freely in. I provide all equipment and props needed for your session.

items.question: Do you accept insurance?
items.answer: Some complementary insurance plans may cover portions of the sessions. I can provide receipts for your insurance submission. Please check with your provider about coverage for alternative therapies.
